scientific_integrity: The exact all-parameter theorem is justified analytically; symbolic and exact-rational checks are supplemental. Historical comparison is provisional and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional strictly positive Dirichlet parameters; no result for sample plug-in indices or arbitrary priors. Targeted priority inspection does not establish exhaustive novelty. The fixed-total bound equality does not imply fixed-total global extremality.
title: Universal negative Shannon–Simpson covariance for arbitrary finite Dirichlet priors
